items.source: Factory method used to create a DockerCompose instance.
items.translation: 用于创建 `DockerCompose` 实例的工厂方法。

items.source: timeout - the amount of time to wait or FORCE_STOP to stop without waiting.
items.translation: timeout - 等待的时间量，或在不等待的情况下使用FORCE_STOP停止。

items.source: logLevel - the log level used to report progress
items.translation: logLevel - 用于报告进度的日志级别

items.source: Run docker compose down to stop and remove any running services.
items.translation: 运行docker compose down以停止并删除任何正在运行的服务。

items.source: Run docker compose stop to stop any running services.
items.translation: 运行docker compose stop以停止任何正在运行的服务。

items.source: Return if services have been defined in the DockerComposeFile for the active profiles.
items.translation: 如果为活动配置文件在DockerComposeFile中定义了服务，则返回。

items.source: Run docker compose up to create and start services. Waits until all contains are started and healthy.
items.translation: 运行docker compose up以创建并启动服务。等待所有容器启动并处于健康状态。

items.source: Run docker compose start to start services. Waits until all containers are started and healthy.
items.translation: 运行docker compose start以启动服务。等待所有容器启动并处于健康状态。

items.source: hostname - the hostname used for services or null if the hostname should be deduced
items.translation: hostname - 用于服务的主机名，或如果应推导主机名则为 null。

items.source: file - the Docker Compose file
items.translation: file - Docker Compose 文件

items.source: activeProfiles - a set of the profiles that should be activated
items.translation: activeProfiles - 应激活的配置文件集合

items.source: Run docker compose start to start services.
items.translation: 运行docker compose start以启动服务。

items.source: Run docker compose up to create and start services.
items.translation: 运行docker compose up以创建并启动服务。

items.source: Timeout duration used to request a forced stop.
items.translation: 用于请求强制停止的超时持续时间。

items.source:
Return the running services for the active profile, or an empty list if no services
are running.
items.translation: 返回活动配置文件正在运行的服务，如果没有正在运行的服务则返回空列表。

items.source: arguments - the arguments to pass to the up command
items.translation: arguments - 要传递给 up 命令的参数

items.source: arguments - the arguments to pass to the down command
items.translation: arguments - 要传递给下行命令的参数

items.source: arguments - the arguments to pass to the start command
items.translation: arguments - 要传递给启动命令的参数

items.source: arguments - the arguments to pass to the stop command
items.translation: arguments - 要传递给停止命令的参数

items.source: true if services have been defined
items.translation: true 如果已定义服务

items.source: arguments - the arguments to pass to Docker Compose
items.translation: arguments - 要传递给 Docker Compose 的参数

items.source: the list of running services
items.translation: 运行中的服务列表

items.source: Provides a high-level API to work with Docker compose.
items.translation: 提供与 Docker Compose 交互的高级 API。
